name: import
code: p=groups[0]; c=p.children[0]; leaf=c.children[0]; held=leaf.mesh; assert held is groups[1].mesh

name: nested-create
code: new=Group(held,name='NestedNew'); new.xform=type(p.xform)(); new.xform.translate(.125,.25,.5); wrap=Group(name='Wrapper'); wrap.adopt([new]); wrap.component=False; p.children.append(wrap); assert wrap.children[0] is new; assert new.mesh is held

name: children-replace
code: saved=p.children; p.children=list(saved); assert p.children is not saved; assert p.children[1] is wrap
